criteria.name: Authentication regressions
criteria.requirement: Synthetic test evidence must explicitly demonstrate that expired sessions and cross-tenant access are rejected, with no failing tests in either case.

criteria.name: Breaking database migration
criteria.requirement: Synthetic migration instructions must explain the users.tenant_id NOT NULL change, a backup step, backfill before applying the constraint, and a rollback procedure.

criteria.name: Breaking API documentation
criteria.requirement: Synthetic release notes must identify the removal of /v1/session, its /v2/session replacement, and the minimum compatible client version 2.0.
